sections.headline: Taste the freshness
sections.body:
Enjoy pure water every time with our UV technology, which eliminates \*99.99% of bacteria.
Play videoPause video
disclaimers: *The UVnano (function name: Self Care) was assessed by laboratory tests by TÜV Rheinland using internal testing methods of measuring reduction of E. coli, S. aureus and P. aeruginosa in distilled water samples after exposure to the product’s UV LED for 10 minutes each hour, after a total of 24 hours in normal household use. Actual results may vary depending on environmental conditions and usage. The product does not treat Air cure health-related conditions and does not guarantee that water filtered by the product will be free from contaminants such as microbiological particles affecting health of users.
*UVnano is a compound of the words UV(ultraviolet) and nanometer(unit of length).

assets.alt: LG refrigerator water dispenser, pouring water into glass from sleek metallic nozzle.

sections.headline: Preserves the freshness of nature
sections.body:
The new premium French-door refrigerator’s advanced cooling technology keeps your produce at peak freshness.
Toggle Contents
LinearCooling™ reduces temperature fluctuations to within ±0.5℃\*\*\*.
DoorCooling+™ air vents located at the front of the fridge keep drinks colder and food fresher.
Pure N Fresh™ uses a carbon filtration system to keep the inside of your fridge odour-free, clean, and fresh.
Previous Slide
1 / 3
Next Slide
Close Contents
disclaimers: **Keep food fresh for up to 7 days\*\***
*Product image is for illustrative purpose only and may differ from actual product.

*\*Based on UL test results using LG’s internal testing method measuring the time it took to reach the 5% weight reduction rate of pak choi on the shelf of the fresh food compartment of the LGE LinearCooling™ model. Applicable models only. The result may vary in actual usage.

*\*\*Based on UL test results using LG’s internal testing method measuring the average peak to peak temperature fluctuation in the fresh food compartment at the factory temperature setting under no load condition. Applicable models only. The result may vary in actual usage.

sections.headline: Experience a smart life: Stay connected with LG ThinQ™
sections.body:
Manage your refrigerator easily and receive the latest alerts from anywhere with the LG ThinQ™ app.
[Learn more about ThinQ app](https://www.lg.com/uk/thinq-up/)
Toggle Contents
The LG ThinQ™ app gives you smart fridge monitoring and allows you to activate the 'Express Freeze' feature with just a tap of a button.
Forgot to close the refrigerator door? Not to worry. The LG ThinQ™ app will send a notification to your phone to alert you.
Close Contents
disclaimers: **Control your fridge with ease from anywhere**
*ThinQ functions may vary depending on the product and country. Check with your local retailer or LG for service availability.

assets.alt: There's a refrigerator and mobile phone.
A smart LG refrigerator displaying temperature settings on a smartphone, with a person holding the phone in a modern kitchen.
Person receiving notification on smartphone that LG ThinQ refrigerator door is open.

sections.headline: Smart Fresh Air
sections.body:
Smart Fresh Air optimizes refrigerator performance by analyzing usage patterns over a 3-week period. It activates increased cooling 2 hours before your peak usage to maintain optimal temperature and freshness for your stored food.
Play videoPause video

assets.alt: LG fridge interior showing organised food items, next to an energy-saving mode graph.

sections.headline: Economic Care+
sections.body:
Economic Care+ identifies periods of reduced refrigerator usage based on your usage patterns over a 3-week period. Save mode slows down compressor movements to reduce energy consumption.
Play videoPause video

assets.alt: Open refrigerator with various food items and a temperature graph showing consistent cooling performance over three weeks.

sections.headline: Smart Ice Plus
sections.body:
The Smart Ice Plus algorithm determines the amount of ice taken by customers and delivers more ice quickly to customers who need a lot of ice.
Play videoPause video

assets.alt: Using a lot of ice and charging the ice quickly

sections.headline: Cool faster, save energy
sections.body: The LG Inverter Linear Compressor™ maintains ideal temperatures efficiently and quickly, with a 10-year warranty on compressor parts.
disclaimers: *Inverter Linear Compressor™: As Inverter Linear Compressor™ can precisely control both speed & distance of compressor parts with a unique direct transmission mechanism. And thanks to its simple components with fewer friction points for less wear and tear, Inverter Linear Compressor™ consumes less energy during operation, making the refrigerator so durable and quiet. Compared to the refrigerator with LG conventional reciprocating compressor. Based on VDE testing comparing energy consumption and noise level between LGE model GBB530NSCXE and GBB530NSQWB.
